title: Normalized scalar squares for individual tensor and projection maps
statement: For each finite reduction of the normalized integral datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum], there exist natural tensor-coordinate isomorphisms to the finite partial tensor at the actual reductions (the second input lifted to finite Tor by [def-sf-integral-projection-reduction-coordinates]). In these same coordinates, each individual integral compactification projection and each individual proper counit projection commute with reduction and the corresponding finite projection, using the prescribed support/direct/pullback comparison components. This asserts no composition, pentagon, or proper-coincidence identity.

proof.text: Obtain realized coefficient-system operations and the finite-evaluation tensor comparison e. Take its components as t. The two tensor naturality equations follow by applying naturality of e to (a,id) and (id,b).

proof.text: Use integral residue Tor for L. Apply the existing integralProjectionReductionNormalization whole-system square. Evaluate it at m, paste the three endpoint/map evaluation identities, and use naturality of reductionEvaluation. Cancel its source isomorphism and use faithfulness of the full finite inclusion. This proves the single-compactification finite square without any appeal to joint faithfulness of system evaluation.

proof.text: Apply the whole-system proper counit normalization and the same finite-evaluation calculation at the identity-open compactification. Tensor naturality and coefficient compatibility of properIdentity identify the source conjugations. Naturality of finite properIdentity and its coefficient compatibility identify the target conjugations. Cancel the two conjugations by the isomorphism identities; the remaining finite map is definitionally properComponent.

theorem integralProjection_reduction_coordinates
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (d : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : TensorCoordinates d m,
      (∀ (X : SixFunctorSpace D)
        (K K' L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left) (a : K ⟶ K'),
        (reduction d m X).map (((d.higher.integralTensor X).map a).app L) ≫
            (t X K' L).hom =
          (t X K L).hom ≫
            ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor (stage d m) X).map
              ((reduction d m X).map a)).app ((torReduction d m X).obj L)) ∧
      (∀ (X : SixFunctorSpace D)
        (K L L' : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left) (b : L ⟶ L'),
        (reduction d m X).map (((d.higher.integralTensor X).obj K).map b) ≫
            (t X K L').hom =
          (t X K L).hom ≫
            ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor (stage d m) X).obj
              ((reduction d m X).obj K)).map ((torReduction d m X).map b)) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
        [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
        (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
        (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left),
        (reduction d m Y).map
            (compactSupportProjectionComponent d.higher.integralExchange f c K L) ≫
            (targetIso d m t f c K L).hom =
          (sourceIso d m t f c K L).hom ≫
            CompactSupportFiniteProjection.component (stage d m) f c
              ((reduction d m X).obj K) ((torReduction d m Y).obj L)) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f.hom.left]
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
        (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left),
        (reduction d m Y).map
            (compactSupportProperProjection d.higher.integralExchange f K L) ≫
            (properTargetIso d m t f K L).hom =
          (properSourceIso d m t f K L).hom ≫
            CompactSupportFiniteProjection.properComponent (stage d m) f
              ((reduction d m X).obj K) ((torReduction d m Y).obj L))
